title: Co kdybys cestoval 100 let do minulosti? Praha 1926
title_options: Co kdybys cestoval 100 let do minulosti? Praha 1926
Probudíš se v Praze roku 1926. Jak dlouho vydržíš?
character: a cartoon character with a large perfectly round white head (about one third of his height) with a thin clean black outline, two small black dot eyes and a small simple mouth (no nose, no ears, no hair), wearing a bright orange hoodie (#FF7A1A) with hood, drawstrings and a kangaroo pocket, dark blue jeans and white sneakers, round white mitten-like hands, sometimes holding a black smartphone
style: 2D hand-drawn explainer illustration, simple round-headed cartoon characters (large round white heads, dot eyes, white mitten hands, clothed bodies, thin clean black outlines, flat colors) placed on richly detailed painted backgrounds, muted vintage palette of sepia, warm grey and teal (1920s feel), flat shading, subtle paper texture, soft natural light, cinematic 16:9 composition, no text, no letters, no captions, no watermark

scenes.narration: Zavřeš oči uprostřed Václavského náměstí. Telefon v ruce, sluchátka v uších. Otevřeš je… a telefon nemá signál. Ne na pět minut. Na dalších sedmdesát let. Je rok 1926.
scenes.image: The main character standing in the middle of Wenceslas Square in Prague in 1926, looking down in confusion at his smartphone whose screen shows a crossed-out signal icon. Around him: 1920s trams, horse-drawn carts, round-headed cartoon men in hats and long coats. The National Museum building at the top of the square in the background. Overcast morning light.

3–6 s: he looks up and turns his head left and right in disbelief, eyebrows raised.
6–8 s: the tram already in the frame rolls a short distance forward and two pedestrians in hats take a few steps past him.

The buildings, the National Museum and the sky stay still and do not change shape. The orange-hoodie character keeps his round white head, dot eyes, orange hoodie, jeans and white sneakers exactly as in the start frame.

Duration 8 seconds. Audio: quiet street ambience and a distant tram bell, no music, no speech.

scenes.narration: Kolem cinká tramvaj, kůň táhne povoz se sudy piva a pán v buřince na tebe zírá, jako bys spadl z Marsu. Což vlastně skoro sedí.
scenes.image: Medium shot: a round-headed cartoon gentleman in a bowler hat and long coat staring in shock at the main character. Behind them a horse-drawn wagon loaded with wooden beer barrels and a 1920s Prague tram in red and cream livery.

motion.prompt: Pomalý zoom na šokovaný obličej pána v buřince.

scenes.narration: V tomhle videu zjistíme, jak dlouho bys v Praze roku 1926 vydržel. Kde bys spal, co bys jedl, za co bys platil – a jaká drobnost by tě mohla zabít během prvních pěti minut.
scenes.image: Clean title-card composition: the main character in the center surrounded by four small vignettes in the same style: a simple bed, a plate of dumplings, old coins, and a vintage 1920s automobile. Large empty plain area in the upper third reserved for a title.

motion.prompt: Ikonky postupně naskakují (pop-in); nahoru titulek „PRAHA 1926“ vložený v Remotionu.

scenes.narration: Začneme tou drobností. Vystoupíš z chodníku, podíváš se doleva, jak tě to učili ve škole… a málem tě srazí auto. Zprava. V Československu se totiž v roce 1926 jezdí vlevo. Jako dnes v Londýně. Na pravou stranu se přejde až v roce 1939.
scenes.image: A Prague street in 1926: the main character stepping off the curb while looking to the LEFT, while a black 1920s automobile approaches from the RIGHT driving on the left side of the road, the round-headed cartoon driver honking. Comic near-miss moment.

motion.prompt:
2D hand-drawn cartoon animation. Keep the exact art style, colors, line work and composition of the start frame; flat illustrated look, no 3D, no realism, no new objects or people.

Camera: completely static, locked-off wide shot, no pan, no zoom.

Action, in this order:
0–3 s: the black 1920s car that is already in the frame drives a short distance toward the orange-hoodie character along the left side of the road.
3–5 s: the car brakes hard and stops just in front of him; a small cartoon puff of dust appears at the wheels. The driver leans out and shakes his fist.
5–8 s: the orange-hoodie character turns his head to the right, his eyes go wide in shock, and he hops one step back onto the sidewalk with both hands raised.

The buildings, street and other people stay still. The character keeps his round white head, dot eyes, orange hoodie, jeans and white sneakers exactly as in the start frame; the car keeps its shape and color.

Duration 8 seconds. Audio: car engine, a screech of brakes and one honk, no music, no speech.

scenes.narration: Dobře, přežil jsi. Rozhlédneš se. Tramvaje jezdí přímo středem Václavského náměstí. Aut je málo, víc je povozů, kol a chodců. A všichni nosí klobouk. Opravdu všichni. Vyjít ven bez klobouku je jako dnes vyjít ven v pyžamu.
scenes.image: Wide high-angle view of Wenceslas Square in 1926: trams running down the middle of the boulevard, few cars, horse carts, bicycles, crowds of round-headed cartoon pedestrians all wearing hats (bowler hats, fedoras, women in cloche hats). The main character is the only bareheaded person and clearly stands out in his orange hoodie.

motion.prompt: Pomalý pan shora dolů, na konci zoom na hlavu bez klobouku.

scenes.narration: A ten vzduch. Praha topí uhlím – v každém domě, v každé kuchyni. V zimě visí nad městem šedá deka kouře a fasády jsou černé od sazí.
scenes.image: Prague rooftops in winter 1926: dozens of chimneys releasing coal smoke, a grey haze over the city, Prague Castle faintly visible in the distance, soot-darkened facades. On the street below, the main character coughing into his sleeve.

motion.prompt:
2D hand-drawn cartoon animation. Keep the exact art style, colors, line work and composition of the start frame; flat illustrated look, no 3D, no realism, no new objects.

Camera: completely static, locked-off shot, no pan, no zoom.

Action: thin wisps of grey coal smoke rise slowly and steadily from the chimneys and drift gently to the right, drawn as soft stylized cartoon smoke. In the lower part of the frame, the orange-hoodie character coughs twice into his sleeve, his round head bobbing slightly with each cough, then waves the smoke away from his face with one hand.

Everything else stays still: buildings, rooftops, Prague Castle and the sky do not move or change shape. The character keeps his round white head, dot eyes, orange hoodie, jeans and white sneakers exactly as in the start frame.

Duration 8 seconds. Audio: soft winter wind and two muffled coughs, no music, no speech.

scenes.narration: Abys věděl, kam ses dostal: Československo existuje teprve osm let. Prezidentem je Tomáš Garrigue Masaryk a lidé mu říkají tatíček. Republika je mladá, sebevědomá a patří k průmyslově nejvyspělejším zemím Evropy.
scenes.image: A 1920s office wall with a framed formal portrait of an elderly round-headed cartoon figure with a white goatee and pince-nez glasses, a Czechoslovak flag beside it, and a window showing factory chimneys and a bustling city.

motion.prompt: Pomalý zoom od okna na portrét.

scenes.narration: A Praha je najednou velkoměsto. Před čtyřmi lety se k ní připojily desítky okolních obcí – Vinohrady, Žižkov, Smíchov, Karlín – a vznikla takzvaná Velká Praha. Žije tu přes sedm set tisíc lidí.
scenes.image: Hand-drawn vintage-style illustrated map of Prague seen from above: the Vltava river, the historic center in the middle, surrounding districts drawn as separate soft-colored patches with factories and new apartment blocks at the edges. Cartographic style matching the explainer look, no labels.

motion.prompt: Okolní čtvrti se postupně „přicvaknou“ k centru (masky v Remotionu); popisky Vinohrady, Žižkov, Smíchov, Karlín doplnit v Remotionu.

scenes.narration: Na ulici uslyšíš češtinu, ale taky němčinu. Praha je město tří kultur – české, německé a židovské – a potkávají se tu v kavárnách, divadlech i na trzích.
scenes.image: A busy 1926 Prague street market: groups of round-headed cartoon figures in varied period clothing chatting, a market vendor, a businessman in a suit, a shopkeeper in front of his small shop; speech bubbles containing only abstract squiggles.

motion.prompt: Pomalý boční pan přes trh.

scenes.narration: A až dojdeš na Staroměstské náměstí, uvidíš radnici celou. I s velkým novogotickým křídlem, které v posledních dnech války shoří a už nikdy se neobnoví.
scenes.image: Old Town Square in Prague in 1926 showing the Old Town Hall complete with its large neo-gothic east wing next to the clock tower, the Týn Church in the background; the main character looking up at the building from the square; a few small pigeons sit on the cobblestones near him.

motion.prompt:
2D hand-drawn cartoon animation. Keep the exact art style, colors, line work and composition of the start frame; flat illustrated look, no 3D, no realism, no new objects or people.

Action, in this order:
0–2 s: a few small cartoon pigeons sitting on the cobblestones flutter up and fly out of the frame to the right.
2–5 s: the orange-hoodie character tilts his head back and looks up at the town hall with his mouth open in awe.
5–8 s: he raises one hand and points up at the large neo-gothic wing.

The town hall, the clock tower, the Týn Church and the other buildings stay completely still and keep their exact shape. The orange-hoodie character keeps his round white head, dot eyes, orange hoodie, jeans and white sneakers exactly as in the start frame.

Duration 8 seconds. Audio: square ambience and pigeon wings fluttering, no music, no speech.

scenes.narration: Teď první velký problém: peníze. Platí se korunou československou. Tvoje karta je kousek plastu, se kterým nikdo nic neudělá. A mince v kapse? Mají letopočty z budoucnosti. Když je zkusíš utratit, v lepším případě se ti vysmějí. V horším zavolají strážníka.
scenes.image: Inside a small 1920s grocery shop: the main character holding out a modern plastic payment card to a round-headed cartoon shopkeeper in an apron who stares at it in total confusion. Wooden counter, brass scales, glass jars.

motion.prompt: Zoom na kartu, pak na zmatený výraz prodavače.

scenes.narration: A strážník bude chtít vědět, kdo jsi. V téhle době má každý takzvanou domovskou příslušnost – obec, ke které patří a která se o něj postará, když přijde o všechno. Ty nepatříš nikam. Nemáš papíry, adresu ani nikoho, kdo by se za tebe zaručil.
scenes.image: A 1920s policeman in a dark uniform and cap, holding a small notebook in one hand and a pencil in the other, frowning at the main character, who stands in front of him nervously with his hands at his sides. Both are shown full-body, medium-large in the frame, facing each other. Quiet Prague street background.

motion.prompt:
2D hand-drawn cartoon animation. Keep the exact art style, colors, line work and composition of the start frame; flat illustrated look, no 3D, no realism, no new objects or people.

0–3 s: the policeman taps his small notebook twice with a pencil and leans slightly forward, frowning.
3–6 s: the orange-hoodie character pulls the empty pockets of his jeans inside out.
6–8 s: he shrugs with both hands raised and gives a nervous smile.

The street and background stay still. The policeman keeps his uniform and cap. The orange-hoodie character keeps his round white head, dot eyes, orange hoodie, jeans and white sneakers exactly as in the start frame.

Duration 8 seconds. Audio: light street ambience and a pencil tapping, no music, no speech.

scenes.narration: Takže úkol číslo jedna: vydělat peníze. Tvoje bunda, tenisky a hlavně telefon jsou na rok 1926 zázraky techniky. Jenže zkus v zastavárně vysvětlit, co je dotykový displej. Nejrealističtější cesta? Práce.
scenes.image: A dim 1920s pawn shop: an old round-headed cartoon pawnbroker with a jeweler's loupe suspiciously examining the glowing smartphone, shelves full of clocks, violins and pocket watches; the main character waiting hopefully.

motion.prompt: Pomalý zoom na svítící telefon v rukou zastavárníka.

scenes.narration: Práce se najít dá. Republika má od roku 1918 zákon o osmihodinové pracovní době – na svou dobu docela pokrokový. Jenže osm hodin v továrně v Libni nebo na Smíchově je úplně jiná liga než osm hodin u počítače.
scenes.image: Interior of a 1920s Prague factory hall with large machines, drive belts and steam; round-headed cartoon workers in caps and overalls; the main character among them, holding a heavy metal part in both hands, exhausted and sweating. The machines, drive belts and workers are clearly visible and medium-large in the frame.

scenes.narration: Bez papírů a bez řemesla tě čeká to nejtěžší – nosič, pomocník na stavbě, vykládání uhlí. A staví se hodně. Roste Veletržní palác, nové čtvrti, nové činžáky. Ruce jsou potřeba.
scenes.image: Construction site of a large modernist building with a concrete frame and wooden scaffolding in Prague, 1926; round-headed cartoon workers carrying bricks; the main character carrying a heavy sack of coal on his back.

motion.prompt: Pomalý pan zdola nahoru po lešení.

scenes.narration: Ale tvoje skutečná superschopnost je jinde. Ty víš, co přijde. Víš, že filmy brzy promluví. Že rádio bude v každé domácnosti. Jenže kdo by věřil chlápkovi v teniskách, který tvrdí, že zná budoucnost?
scenes.image: A smoky 1920s pub: the main character enthusiastically explaining something to a table of round-headed cartoon men in flat caps who laugh at him; above him a thought bubble containing a simple television, a radio and an airplane drawn in simple lines.

motion.prompt: Bublina s myšlenkou se nafoukne (scale-in), lehké třesení smíchem.

scenes.narration: Máš první výplatu. Kde budeš spát? Na Žižkově nebo v Libni můžeš být takzvaný nocležník – platíš si jen postel v cizím bytě. Někdy jen na pár hodin, než ji uvolní někdo z noční směny.
scenes.image: A cramped 1920s working-class room: one shared bed, a round-headed cartoon worker in overalls getting out of it at dawn while the main character waits beside it holding a small bundle; a family sleeping in the background.

motion.prompt: Pomalý zoom na postel, přechod denního světla.

scenes.narration: Typický byt? Jedna místnost a kuchyň pro celou rodinu. Záchod? Na pavlači, společný pro celé patro. Koupelna? Většinou žádná. Koupat se chodíš do lázní, tak jednou týdně.
scenes.image: Close view of one open balcony corridor (pavlač) of an old Prague tenement building, seen from the courtyard: a small closed wooden toilet door at the end of the corridor, a queue of four round-headed cartoon people in period clothing waiting in front of it, the first one holding a folded newspaper, and the main character standing last in the queue holding his smartphone. Laundry hangs on a line above the railing. The door and the queue are medium-large in the frame.

scenes.narration: Elektřina v Praze už je, ale ne všude. Ve starších domech se svítí petrolejkou nebo plynem. A večer chodí ulicemi lampář a rozsvěcuje plynové lampy jednu po druhé.
scenes.image: Dusk on a cobblestone street in Prague's Lesser Town: a round-headed cartoon lamplighter in a coat and cap standing next to an UNLIT gas street lamp, holding a long pole lowered at his side; the main character standing nearby, watching curiously. The lamp and both characters are medium-large in the frame.

scenes.narration: Dobrá zpráva je jídlo. Česká kuchyně roku 1926 by ti byla povědomá – knedlíky, zelí, polévky, buchty. Jenže maso je svátek, ne samozřejmost. Běžně se jí brambory, chleba, luštěniny a hodně sádla.
scenes.image: A simple wooden kitchen table in a 1920s Czech working-class home: a bowl of potato soup, a loaf of bread, a plate of dumplings with sauerkraut, a jar of lard; the main character eating together with a round-headed cartoon family.

motion.prompt: Pomalý pan přes stůl.

scenes.narration: Lednička? Zapomeň. Máš nanejvýš chladnou spíž nebo kus ledu, který přiveze ledař. Nakupuje se proto každý den – na trhu nebo u hokynáře na rohu.
scenes.image: A round-headed cartoon iceman carrying a large block of ice on his shoulder with iron tongs, walking from a horse-drawn ice wagon into a tenement doorway; the main character holding the door open.

motion.prompt: Pomalý zoom, ledař projde zleva doprava (parallax vrstvy).

scenes.narration: A pivo teče proudem. Hospoda je centrum všeho – řeší se tu politika, práce i fotbal. Sparta a Slavia jsou největší rivalové už tehdy.
scenes.image: Lively 1920s Prague pub interior with wooden tables and foamy beer mugs; two round-headed cartoon figures arguing passionately about football, one wearing a dark red scarf, the other a red-and-white scarf; the main character between them holding a beer.

motion.prompt: Rychlý zoom střídavě na oba fanoušky (komický efekt).

scenes.narration: A teď to vážné. Největší nebezpečí roku 1926 nejsou zloději ani auta jezdící vlevo. Jsou to bacily.
scenes.image: Dramatic dark composition: the main character standing in the center, about one third of the frame height, looking worried; around him float six giant hand-drawn cartoon microbes and bacteria with simple round and rod shapes in muted green and dusty purple, each clearly separated from him. Plain dark teal background with a soft spotlight on the character, ominous mood.

scenes.narration: Antibiotika neexistují. Penicilin objeví Alexander Fleming až za dva roky a do běžné léčby se dostane až ve čtyřicátých letech. Obyčejná infekce z řezné rány může být smrtelná.
scenes.image: A 1920s doctor's office: a round-headed cartoon doctor with a head mirror and a black leather bag bandaging the main character's cut hand; shelves of glass medicine bottles.

motion.prompt: Pomalý zoom na obvázanou ruku.

scenes.narration: Tuberkulóze se tu říká vídeňská nemoc a zabíjí hlavně mladé lidi v přeplněných, vlhkých bytech. Přesně v takových, kde bys bydlel ty.
scenes.image: A dim, damp, crowded tenement room with mold stains on the walls, a pale round-headed cartoon figure coughing in bed, a small window letting in grey light.

motion.prompt: Velmi pomalý zoom, postupná desaturace.

scenes.narration: Tvoje šance? Paradoxně slušné. Víš, že si máš mýt ruce, převařit vodu a větrat. Tyhle drobnosti tu nejsou samozřejmost – a v roce 1926 ti můžou zachránit život.
scenes.image: The main character washing his hands with soap at an enamel basin, a kettle boiling on a cast-iron stove, an open window letting in bright sunlight; hopeful bright mood.

motion.prompt: Prosvětlení obrazu, lehký zoom-out.

scenes.narration: Když přežiješ, Praha ti nabídne neuvěřitelně živé město. Kavárny jsou plné spisovatelů, malířů a novinářů. U jednoho kafe můžeš sedět celé odpoledne a číst noviny – mají jich tu desítky.
scenes.image: Elegant 1920s Prague grand café interior: tall windows overlooking the Vltava river and Prague Castle, marble tables, round-headed cartoon figures reading newspapers on wooden holders, a waiter in a tailcoat; the main character sitting at a marble table with a cup of coffee in front of him on the table, his hands resting next to it.

scenes.narration: Možná tu potkáš Karla Čapka. Jeho hra R.U.R. dala světu slovo robot – a ty jsi jediný člověk v Praze, který ví, jak moc to slovo zdomácní. Franze Kafku ale nepotkáš. Zemřel před dvěma lety a o jeho budoucí slávě zatím nikdo nemá tušení.
scenes.image: In the café: a round-headed cartoon writer with slicked-back dark hair and a pipe writing at a table covered in papers; above him a whimsical thought bubble with a simple boxy cartoon robot; the main character at the next table grinning knowingly.

motion.prompt: Robot v bublině se lehce pohupuje (wiggle), zoom na úsměv hlavní postavy.

scenes.narration: V kinech běží němé filmy a hraje k nim živý klavír nebo orchestr. Mluvený film dorazí až na konci dvacátých let.
scenes.image: Inside a 1920s cinema: a black-and-white silent film projected on the screen, a round-headed cartoon pianist playing an upright piano below the screen, an audience of round-headed cartoon figures in hats, a visible beam of light from the projector.

The cinema hall, the screen frame and the seats stay still. All people keep their round white heads and hats.

scenes.narration: A rádio? Úplná novinka. Radiojournal vysílá pravidelně teprve od roku 1923 – první vysílání šlo ze stanu ve Kbelích. Rádio doma je luxus a poslouchá se často jen na sluchátka.
scenes.image: A 1920s living room: a family crowding around a small crystal radio set, one round-headed cartoon figure wearing big headphones listening in amazement while the others wait their turn; the main character smirking while holding his modern wireless earbuds.

scenes.narration: A v létě roku 1926 zažiješ něco, co dnes nemá obdoby – všesokolský slet. Desítky tisíc lidí cvičí naráz v dokonalé souhře a celé město žije jen tímhle.
scenes.image: A huge stadium field seen from above: tens of thousands of round-headed cartoon gymnasts in white and red outfits standing in perfect geometric formation with their arms at their sides, ready to start a synchronized exercise, packed wooden grandstands, Czechoslovak flags.

motion.prompt:
2D hand-drawn cartoon animation. Keep the exact art style, colors, line work and composition of the start frame; flat illustrated look, no 3D, no realism, no new objects or people.

Camera: completely static, locked-off shot, no pan, no zoom.

Action, in this order:
0–3 s: all gymnasts on the field raise their arms up at the same moment in perfect unison.
3–5 s: they hold the pose.
5–8 s: they lower their arms together; the flags at the stadium flutter gently.

The stadium, the grandstands and the geometric formation stay still and keep their exact shape; the gymnasts move only their arms.

Duration 8 seconds. Audio: a distant brass band and crowd applause, no music, no speech.

scenes.narration: Takže – jak dlouho bys vydržel? První den je nejnebezpečnější: auta zprava, žádné peníze, žádné papíry. Když najdeš práci a postel, první měsíc zvládneš. A když se vyhneš infekcím, klidně i roky.

motion.prompt: Panely naskakují postupně; nad ně čísla „1 den / 1 měsíc / roky“ v Remotionu.

scenes.narration: Jenže je tu ještě jedna věc. Ty víš, co přijde potom. Krize. Mnichov. Válka. Celá tahle Praha – kavárny, Sokol, svobodné noviny – se za pouhých třináct let změní k nepoznání.
scenes.image: The main character standing alone on Charles Bridge at dusk, seen from behind, looking over the Vltava toward Prague Castle; a long shadow, dark storm clouds gathering on the horizon; melancholic mood.

motion.prompt:
2D hand-drawn cartoon animation. Keep the exact art style, colors, line work and composition of the start frame; flat illustrated look, no 3D, no realism, no new objects or people.

Camera: completely static, locked-off shot, no pan, no zoom.

Action, in this order:
0–8 s: the dark clouds on the horizon drift slowly and grow a little darker, and the light over the scene dims slightly.
3–6 s: the orange-hoodie character slowly lowers his head.
6–8 s: his shoulders drop and he stays still, looking at Prague Castle.

Charles Bridge, the river, Prague Castle and the statues stay completely still and keep their exact shape. The orange-hoodie character keeps his round white head, dot eyes, orange hoodie, jeans and white sneakers exactly as in the start frame.

Duration 8 seconds. Audio: soft wind and distant church bells, no music, no speech.

scenes.narration: Takže otázka nezní, jestli bys v roce 1926 přežil. Otázka zní, jestli bys dokázal mlčet.
scenes.image: Close-up of the main character's face with a finger on his lips in a 'shh' gesture, sepia Prague softly blurred behind him.

scenes.narration: Příště se podíváme ještě dál – do středověkých Čech. A tam by to bylo mnohem horší.
